summary: Independent DAY underwriting pass prioritizes the open XTND capital-structure gap. Primary SEC evidence materially strengthens dilution-risk visibility: the Sept. 4 S-8 registers 43,567,442 shares across rollover awards, the 2026 incentive plan and ESPP, and a same-day S-3 creates additional financing optionality. These facts reinforce the existing prohibition on admission/scoring until the post-close basic/fully diluted denominator and normalized cash runway are reconciled without double counting.

materialFindings.finding: XTND remains outside_challenger_pending_full_methodology with admissionEligible=false; the canonical discovery record itself says full methodology score and dilution/capital-structure review are pending.

XTND's Sept. 4, 2026 Form S-8 registers 9,936,483 rollover-award shares, 18,630,959 shares under the 2026 Equity Incentive Plan, and 15,000,000 shares under the 2026 ESPP, an aggregate 43,567,442 registered plan/award shares. Registration is not equivalent to immediate dilution, so these amounts must be reconciled against existing rollover awards and the post-close denominator before calculating fully diluted ownership.

A Sept. 4, 2026 XTND Form S-3 registration statement establishes additional capital-markets financing capacity; it is financing optionality, not evidence that securities have already been issued or that cash runway is solved.

SEC Form 3 for Matteo Shapira reports 3,356,974 common shares plus an option for 2,298,417 shares at $0.47, illustrating that insider derivative awards are material enough to require explicit option/award reconciliation in a fully diluted denominator.

NYSE certification confirms listing/registration of XTND common stock following the Sept. 3 merger close; listing status is therefore primary-source supported but says nothing about underwriting quality or dilution-adjusted valuation.

unknowns: Exact post-close basic common shares outstanding after reconciling merger consideration, legacy JFB holders and any pre-funded warrants.
